cohort: 50 women with atonic postpartum hemorrhage who received uterine balloon tamponade (40 vaginal, 10 cesarean) and 50 women with atonic postpartum hemorrhage who received traditional therapy (40 vaginal, 10 cesarean).
finding: Uterine balloon tamponade reduced blood loss in women experiencing atonic postpartum hemorrhage, both after vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
